basic_info.description:
Funky Noe Valley House w/ Awesome City View - UTILS INCLUDED. FURNISHED ONLY. SHORT TERM LEASES WELCOME (30+ days).

This house features an incredible view of the San Francisco skyline from a large private deck!

2 bedrooms and 2 full bathrooms and full sized Washer Dryer included.

Ground floor bedroom features Queen bed and private desk.

2nd floor bedroom is truly spacious: approximately 700 square feet and spans the entire 2nd floor. Two twin beds and one queen bed. The second private bathroom is on this level.

Full kitchen and large living room and dining area!

Also includes full size washer dryer!

Parking for up to 2 cars (1 in driveway and 1 in front of driveway)

(RLNE6395552)
